scheme_name: Biotechnology Career Advancement And Re-orientation (BioCARe) Programme For Women Scientists
other_conditions: Must not be in regular or permanent employment
Temporary researchers may apply but must resign from their earlier assignment if a project is approved
Must not have previously received any extramural funding as Principal Investigator from any government funding agency
Must not be currently enrolled in a Ph.D. program receiving a fellowship
Must have completed the qualifying degree (Ph.D. or M.Tech/MPharma/MVSc/MD/MDS) before applying
Must not hold any other fellowship, grant, or award that provides salary or stipend concurrently with the BioCARe project
Must not have received funding under any women‑specific scheme of DST or any other agency
Must be an Indian female scientist
Must devote 100% of research time to the BioCARe project
benefits_summary: Provides a research grant of up to ₹60 lakhs (Category‑I) or ₹40 lakhs (Category‑II) with a monthly fellowship for a three‑year project duration.
